layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Theropod 'Gripping Claw' morphology
features: A three-toed clay foot belonging to a medium-sized meat-eater
Each toe is tipped with a dark, curved, hook-shaped clay claw
The claws are sharp at the point but have soft, rounded 'clay-like' edges for safety
The foot is arched slightly, showing the claws ready to grip the ground
Subtle skin folds in the clay around the base of each claw for a realistic but toy-like look
A warm spotlight hitting the side of the claws to show their curved shape
layer_3_action.action: A centered, cinematic macro shot of the claws. The lighting creates a clear silhouette of the 'hook' shape. The rest of the leg fades into a soft, blurry background. No text.
